## 🚀 Feature Rationale & Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or missing SaaS capability? Please describe clearly (e.g., "I'm frustrated when tenant admins cannot...").

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution or feature you would like to see implemented across the monorepo (`backend`, `frontend`, or infrastructure).

## 🔍 Alternative Options Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## 📋 Technical Scope & Impact
- [ ] Frontend UI Component / Dashboard Page
- [ ] Backend API Endpoint / Module
- [ ] Prisma Database Schema Migration
- [ ] Security Guard / RBAC Action
- [ ] Infrastructure / Terraform / Helm Chart

## 🎨 Mockups / Implementation Details
Add any visual mockups, database model snippets, or API design drafts if available.
